title: Negative control: irrelevant general hazard added to one copy
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC FICTIONAL EVIDENCE prepared for a pre-registered prompt experiment. Not a factual claim about any real country, territory, institution or person. No real dossier data is used.
design: REVISED per independent review. Trans-specific evidence is unchanged across copies; only one copy carries an unrelated general travel hazard with no trans-specific dimension and no documented link to gender-nonconforming travellers. The renderer must not announce that the copies share evidence. This tests scope adherence under rule 8 only; numerical divergence alone cannot establish that the hazard caused a change, and this pair says nothing about war, institutional collapse or hazards with plausible trans-specific pathways.
expected_reasoning: The general hazard is out of scope for a trans-specific rating unless it independently raises trans-specific risk, and no such link is documented.
Neither variant may let the unrelated general hazard drive the trans-specific assessment; a difference in trans-specific reasoning is a diagnostic scope failure, not proof that the hazard caused it.
The absence of documented trans-specific violence is not established safety, but it also may not be converted into an invented harm.
